note: Highly productive first element: rauðrófa, rauðvín, rauðkál.
Literally violet-blue: fjóla is the flower (violet). Colours take fjólu-, ljós- and dökk- as first elements.
ljós- (light) and dökk- (dark) combine with any colour.
ró (calm) + -legur. The suffix -legur/-leg/-legt turns a noun into an adjective, like English -ly or German -lich.
The prefix ó- negates any adjective: ódýr, óhreinn, ólíkur.
Indeclinable — one form for every gender and case.
hringur (circle) + -laga (shaped). The ending -laga means shaped like; compare kringlóttur.
